fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Spreadconnect API token (create an API Integration in the Spreadconnect web app; the token is on its dashboard), sent as the `X-SPOD-ACCESS-TOKEN` header.

me.note: GET /authentication returns {merchantId, pointOfSaleId, pointOfSaleName, pointOfSaleType} for the token.

list_products.note: GET /articles lists the articles (your products) of the point of sale: {items[{id, title, description, variants[{id, sku, productTypeName, appearanceName, sizeName, d2cPrice, b2bPrice}], images[{imageUrl}]}], count, limit, offset}. `query` and `category` are not accepted; `sku`/`price` are the first variant's (price = d2cPrice, the end-customer price).

get_product.note: GET /articles/{articleId}: {id, title, description, variants[...], images[...]}; order lines use the variant `sku`. Stock per variant is in GET /stocks (not mapped).

get_order.note: GET /orders/{orderId}: {id, orderReference, externalOrderReference, state (NEW, CONFIRMED, PROCESSED, CANCELLED), orderItems[{sku, quantity, state, price}], shipping{address, type, price}, price{amount, currency}}. Tracking codes come from the track tool.

track.note: GET /orders/{orderId}/shipments returns [{id, orderItemReferences, shipping{type{company, name}, price}, tracking[{code, url}], closedDate, sentDate}]; each shipment is one event (its first tracking code).

not_offered.create_order: POST /orders requires `phone` ('Must not be blank'), `email` ('Must be a valid email address'), `externalOrderReference` ('external order reference from merchant (you). Must not be blank') and shipping{address, customerPrice{amount, currency}} beside orderItems[{sku, quantity, customerPrice}]; the vocabulary carries no customer price, phone or merchant reference, so the body cannot be built without inventing values.
not_offered.quote_shipping: GET /orders/{orderId}/shippingTypes lists shipping types with prices for an existing order only; there is no quote for a product_id/country/quantity before an order exists.

evidence: host api.spreadconnect.app: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
